paraphrase: Huangbo's verse: getting free of the dust of the world is no ordinary matter; grip the rope tight and do the work; unless the cold once pierces to the bone, how could the plum blossom's fragrance strike the nose?

original.text: 塵勞迥脫事非常。緊把繩頭做一場。不是一翻寒徹骨。爭得梅花撲鼻香
